title: Snowball on a Stick
description: Make your happy ghast move faster!
body:
# Give your Happy Ghast a little motivation!

Similar to a carrot or a warped fungus on a stick, you can use the snowball on a stick to give your ghast a speed boost. Simply right-click it while riding your ghast. If you need to go slower again, just use the item again. Make sure you've brought enough snowballs though - you'll eventually need to replace the one on the rod!

The speed boost also runs out after a certain time (default: **40 seconds**). This can be configured
via the `#boost_time` scoreboard value:

```
scoreboard players set #boost_time snowball_on_a_stick 400
```

The example above would set the boost to run out after 400 ticks,
meaning 20 seconds.

You can also set `#boost_time` to `-1` to make the boost last
forever (or until you use the item again):

```
scoreboard players set #boost_time snowball_on_a_stick -1
```

## Resource pack

To download the required resource pack, head to the *Versions* tab, click on the pack version you need, then download the resource pack from the *Files* section.

## Crafting

![Screenshot of a  crafting table in which a fishing rod and a snowball are being combined into a snowball on a stick](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c22f38188e81ce77677d147580600b61aee1d9a6.webp)

## Particle Cloud

While the speed boost is active, your ghasts gets it's own little snow cloud!

![A player sitting on a happy ghast, which has a little snow particle cloud above it, indicating that the speed bost is active](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f6f5f70fcce137d7c18f70a8e1a2528c84e8202_0.webp)

## Inspiration

While I did come up with this concept by myself, it *is* very simple and straightforward, and thus, it seems like it has been done before by [Sapphipenug](https://modrinth.com/user/Sapphipenug) in the form of the data pack [with the same name](https://modrinth.com/project/QCEz8GXH). However, since *a)* she has not updated the pack in almost a year and *b)* I think my version is different enough from hers, I decided to upload it anyways.
